scripts.prestart: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.dev-migrations-up: node scripts/migration-script-dev.js && npx db-migrate up --config database.json -e dev
scripts.dev-migrations-down: node scripts/migration-script-dev.js && npx db-migrate down --config database.json -e dev
scripts.staging-migrations-up: node scripts/migration-script-staging.js && npx db-migrate up --config database.json -e staging
scripts.staging-migrations-down: node scripts/migration-script-staging.js && npx db-migrate down --config database.json -e staging
scripts.prod-migrations-up: node scripts/migration-script-prod.js && npx db-migrate up --config database.json -e production
scripts.prod-migrations-down: node scripts/migration-script-prod.js && npx db-migrate down --config database.json -e production
